name: Abstinence
description: Lose when the opponent has two adjacent non-pawn pieces of the same type.
ambiguities: The condition is evaluated at the affected player's turn start; promoted duplicate piece types count.

name: Always Check, It Might Be Mate
description: Lose when starting a turn in check.

name: Boastful
description: Lose when holding fewer pieces than the opponent.
ambiguities: All current board pieces, including pawns and kings, are counted.

name: Closed Book
description: Lose when any file contains no pawns.

name: Hold Them Back
description: Lose when an opposing pawn reaches the affected player's half of the board.
ambiguities: The player's side is their color-relative four-rank half; promoted pawns no longer count as pawns.

name: Homeland Security
description: Lose when an opposing piece enters either home rank.
ambiguities: The sixteen starting squares are interpreted as the affected player's two home ranks.

name: Ivory Tower
description: Lose when an opposing piece is adjacent to the affected player's king.
ambiguities: Adjacency is physical and does not require the opposing piece to give legal check.

name: King of the Hill
description: After the first turn, lose when no affected piece occupies d4, e4, d5, or e5.
ambiguities: First turn is interpreted independently for each player.

name: Modest
description: Lose when holding more pieces than the opponent.
ambiguities: All current board pieces, including pawns and kings, are counted.

name: Simp
description: Lose when the affected player has no queen.
ambiguities: Any current queen, including a promoted queen, satisfies the condition.

name: Tower Defense
description: Rooks cannot move, and losing every rook causes a loss.
ambiguities: Any current rook, including a promoted rook, satisfies the condition.

name: Warlord
description: From turn twelve onward, lose while the king remains on either home rank.
ambiguities: Move twelve is color-relative; first two ranks means the affected player's two home ranks.
